experiments.model_policy: same resolved model and effort across all arms and iterations
experiments.note: supersedes mode-boundary-ablation: the prompt-scaffolding question is settled (6 fixtures / 17 calls, no correctness lift, 4-10.7x cost); the open question is whether an INDEPENDENT verification loop buys correctness or faster convergence, for scaffolded and bare agents given identical feedback

experiments.entry: only after a verification-loop signal and fresh provider catalog

zero_provider_gates.candidate_suite: run_candidate_evals.py (see evidence/candidate-eval-summary.json for the current count)

decision_rule: Verdicts require >=3 trials per arm (exploratory otherwise). Prefer the cheapest arm whose score distribution is within 3 points median of the best with no additional critical failure. Change boundaries only after replicated evidence on at least two task families.
cost_controls: USD unavailable when subscription CLI does not expose it
